_comment: The quiz's scoring rules, written once. The browser inlines this at build time (scripts/build_quiz.py) and the leaderboard worker gets a copy through scripts/generate_worker_rules.py, so the score you see and the score the board keeps cannot drift apart.
_bonuses: Every bonus needs a clean sheet - all twelve right, no reveals. That is what stops 'reveal everything, collect the finisher bonus' being a strategy, and it is why reveal itself is free.
_clueCosts: Priced by how much each one gives away. A question is worth 100, so an anagram at 65 still leaves 35 on the table - worth buying when you are stuck, never worth buying on spec.
